The model file does not say it *is* 1.34: it says one in ten falls below 1.12, one in ten above 1.60, and that values near the middle come up far more often than values near either end. That is a spread — not one number, but every value the input might take and how often it takes it. Every uncertain input in the model has one, and they are not all this wide.
